intro.name: Viktor Nešić
intro.offer: Viktor Nešić is a senior mobile developer building native iOS, Android and Kotlin Multiplatform apps with Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. Available for freelance and contract projects, working remotely.

caseStudy.title: ÇocukFlix
caseStudy.lead: A safe cartoon app for Turkish children: curated cartoons in Turkish, favourites and notifications, with a parental gate that keeps the settings in grown-up hands.

brief.title: The brief
text: A cartoon app for children in Turkish: curated videos in categories, favourites, and the settings kept behind a parental gate.

contributions.title: What I did
items: Built the iOS app in Swift: categories, details, favourites and the video screen.
Added a parental gate in front of the parental controls.
Integrated push notifications with OneSignal and ads with AdMob.
Loaded content with Alamofire and ObjectMapper, and images with Kingfisher.

team.title: Team
team.text: I built the app myself, working directly with the client.

outcome.title: The result
outcome.text: A focused cartoon app for children, with the settings behind a parental gate.
